snippet.title: Night Shift Hospital - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description: Here's your look at the Night Shift Hospital announcement trailer for the upcoming chaotic co-op job sim for up to 4 players about night-shift doctors. Handle a bizarre stream of patients, diagnose illnesses, and assign people to the correct treatment zones. Work as a team, get through nightly crises, and try your best not to get fired! Night Shift Hospital will be available on PC.
